realm_entry_auto_detect_help: After legacy entry matching fails, confirm a known scene and growth anchor before clicking its card entry. Existing skin recognition remains available.
realm_entry_candidates_help: Choose supported layouts. Only matches above both recognition thresholds qualify; the highest score wins. Currently supports Shen An.
boss_count_mode_help: Automatic: confirmed reward progress plus subsequent wins up to 100. Fixed: skip reward OCR and stop after the configured number of wins. Restart this account task after changing modes.
boss_limit_help: Used only in fixed-count mode; 0 skips battles. Counts wins in this task execution and resets on restart. The total time limit still applies.
owt_exhaust_double_rewards_help: Solo only. Read the remaining bonus before every battle; stop at zero. Time limit remains active; uncertain readings defer 10 minutes.
dedicated_next_run_help: Time of the next queued run; may be edited manually. Subsequent runs follow the task calendar and retry settings, ignoring legacy server-time overrides.
draft_duel_role_help: Choose one leader and one member. The leader invites the configured nickname; the member waits on the current screen. Team only; no challenge starts.
draft_duel_teammate_name_help: Leader: exact member nickname. Member: exact allowed leader nickname.
draft_duel_friend_tab_help: Leader only: choose the friend list to scan.
draft_duel_partner_config_help: Both accounts must name each other and choose opposite team roles. Do not copy these fields through the linker.
